snippet.title: Yume no Office Trailer — Psychological Visual Novel
snippet.description:
Five girls.
Five stories.
A protagonist who begins to remember things he should never have forgotten.

Yume no Office is a visual novel blending romance, drama, and psychological mystery, where every decision brings you closer to a truth that challenges the very nature of reality.

Features:
• Five romantic routes
• Multiple endings
• Psychological mystery and science fiction
• Mini-games and hidden secrets
• Original soundtrack

Add it to your Steam wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2978070/Yume_No_Office/
